---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

```{python}
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

@fig-runtime-rating compares film runtimes with IMDb ratings. Each point represents one film in the dataset.

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Film runtimes and IMDb ratings."
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating (0 to 10)")
plt.show()
```

## Mean rating by decade

The table below shows the average IMDb rating for films released in each decade.

```{python}
#| echo: true

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
